gloss: to warp; to be distorted; to become crooked

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {歪|ゆが}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to warp; to bend out of shape
definitions.explanation: For something to become bent, twisted, or misshapen.

definitions.gloss: to be distorted; to be warped
definitions.explanation: For something abstract like perception, facts, or personality to become twisted or corrupted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}んで⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The wood warped because of the humidity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The glass in the old window is warped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}んで⟦{伝|つた}わっている→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: The facts are being conveyed in a distorted way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}んで⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦せい→せい：10469_sei⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
examples.english: His warped personality is probably due to the environment he grew up in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The pillars of the building were warped from the effects of the earthquake.

notes:
{歪|ゆが}む is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) describing something becoming warped, twisted, or distorted.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{歪|ゆが}める→歪める：28422_yugameru⟧ (to distort, warp something; no separate entry yet)

ASPECT (ている):
{歪|ゆが}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates something is currently in a warped/distorted state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}む — [thing] becomes warped
- ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}む (shape becomes distorted)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}む (face contorts - from pain/emotion)
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}む (facts become distorted)
- ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歪|ゆが}む (personality becomes warped)

USAGE:
{歪|ゆが}む is often used figuratively for distorted perceptions, reports, or personalities that have developed in unhealthy ways.

ALTERNATE READING:
Also read as ひずむ with similar meaning, especially in technical contexts (audio distortion).
